projects.title: Line Item Modeling
projects.description: Myself and two other developers created Line Item Modeling, previously known as People Planning. I personally refactored the Formula Wizard and built the Cube Drivers (depicted above). This project was a OneStream workspace with custom business rules written in .NET 8.

projects.title: Massachusetts Distribution Map
projects.description: This map shows the electrical distribution grid in Massachusetts. I built this using ArcGIS, Python, Azure Functions, and Snowflake. An accompanying data explorer website was built using React and .NET. It's still hosted at the National Grid Massachusetts System Data Portal under Distribution Assets Overview.

projects.title: This website!
projects.description: I built my personal website using Next.js and Typescript. It's hosted on Azure Static Web Apps via a Docker container. You can explore the code at it's GitHub repository.
